Bash(context: "On refresh, the generator must reconcile the subtree with new results: creating nodes for new items, removing nodes for items no longer matching, and updating fields on existing matches. The requirements allow either updating in place or deleting and recreating \(e9671145\).")
Bash(question: "Should refresh reconciliation update existing managed nodes in place \(matching by external identifier\) rather than deleting all managed children and recreating from scratch?")

Bash(intent: "Option 1 updates existing nodes by external-id match — preserves node UUIDs across refreshes, so greyed-out tracking, detail-view history, and any future per-node state survive. More code but stable identities. Option 2 deletes all managed children then recreates — simpler logic, but node IDs change every refresh, breaking any bookmarks or cross-references to managed nodes. If option 1, record update-in-place with external-id matching. If option 2, record delete-and-recreate.")

Bash(text: "Refresh reconciliation updates existing managed nodes in place, matching by external identifier. New items are created; items no longer matching are removed. Node identities \(UUIDs\) are stable across refreshes.")
